title: Rust Tongue
description: A detuned sawtooth reese bass in the mid register, carved by a resonant ladder lowpass that sweeps as a slow degradation arc ramps distortion and waveshaping from clean grind to corroded buzz. Over 24 cycles the filter, drive, and crush all travel on prime-ish clocks so the bass slowly rots and self-heals, with broken stutters and reversed flecks knocking it off the grid.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f2 f2 [f2 ab2] <c2 eb2>>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .add(note("0,0.12,-0.11"))
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(280, 2400)).resonance(sine.slow(17).range(9, 18)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 3 5>/8").lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.2)
    .distort(saw.slow(32).range(0.2, 1.6))
    .shape(sine.slow(19).range(0.2, 0.55))
    .crush("<16 16 10 7>/8")
    .vib("<5 7>/4").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.05, 0.5))
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.18).sustain(0.7).release(0.08)
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).pan(0.75))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .room(0.18).gain(0.9)
)
